dod_intent_evidence: SBIR abstract explicitly states the underlying system is 'TRL-9 land-based SADAR' and LinkedIn about states 'nearly three decades as a US Federal Contractor supporting DoD, DHS, DOE'; a live DHS/CBP definitive contract for a 'Persistent Surveillance And Detection System' is also on record.
